craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at staging/unframing. Device: end-dash→comma (framing softens onto unframing). Rejected: 'playwright' — killed: bard is older, kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Framed the triple stage, seed-pregnant with the true,
Hara, to unframe: what bard but thou suffices?
l4.sanskrit_cite: visṛṣṭānekasadbījagarbhaṃ trailokyanāṭakam prastāvya hara saṃhartuṃ tvattaḥ ko 'nyaḥ kaviḥ kṣamaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Having staged the three-world-play pregnant with true seeds.; O Hara, to dissolve — who but you is a capable poet? → You staged the play; only you, poet, can dissolve it.
c1_essence: Real and fake made nought or aught by free-and-bound spender-sovereign.
reads_against.l2: You set the triple-world drama teeming with live seed — Hara, to strike the set, what playwright but you has skill?
l3: Framed the triple stage, seed-pregnant with the true —
Hara, to unframe: what bard but thou suffices?
reads_against.t1: Having staged the three-world-play pregnant with many true emitted seeds — O Hara, to dissolve it, who but you is a capable poet?
